verdict.rationale: A cloud platform could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so the axis applies. However, the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger document at any candidate path, and nothing in the evidence documents an equivalent downloadable schema. The llms.txt file, MCP server and CLI are related agent-facing features, not an API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
